problem.paragraph: Compute the first partial derivatives of $$f\left( {x,y} \right) = x^{3} - 2xy^{2} + y^{2} - 8$$ .

solution.paragraph: $$\begin{array}{rcl} f_{x} & = & {\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = 3x^{2} - 2y^{2}} \\ f_{y} & = & {\frac{\partial f}{\partial y} = - 2x\left( {2y} \right) + 2y} \\ & = & {2y\left( {1 - 2x} \right)} \end{array}$$
